propositions: T3 and T10 criteria never blocked despite ~2,500 runs each due to a configuration artifact rather than low quality.
T3 and T10 are promoted to default_posture blocking with block_threshold 0.90 as a conservative pilot.
A T10 DET overlay gate is added as an infra-vocabulary DetGateRule with an audit-verbatim regex and no file_impact arms.
T10 rubric gains a one-sentence MAJOR-class severity guidance so only destructive/overbroad/secret/unauthenticated findings reach the threshold.
Multiple pinned test assertions (full routing table and approved-blocking set) across test files are updated to reflect T3/T10 blocking.
Pass-3 blocks findings above the threshold and keeps those below advisory, and the DET gate fires on terraform/GHA fixtures while det-gating pure-docs plans.
